final class RoomSettingsTests: XCTestCase {
    func testOpenBookClubNotifications() throws {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.wait(for: .runningForeground, timeout: 10))
        print("ELEMENT_ACCESSIBILITY_TREE_START\n\(app.debugDescription)\nELEMENT_ACCESSIBILITY_TREE_END")
        let roomText = app.staticTexts.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS[c] %@", "Book Club")).firstMatch

        roomText.press(forDuration: 1.2)
        print("ELEMENT_AFTER_LONG_PRESS\n\(app.debugDescription)")
        let notifications = app.descendants(matching: .any).matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS[c] %@", "Notifications")).firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(notifications.waitForExistence(timeout: 5), "No Notifications action appeared after the long press")
        notifications.tap()
        sleep(2)
        print("ELEMENT_AFTER_NOTIFICATIONS\n\(app.debugDescription)")
    }
}
EOF
